sourceLore.details: Branches flowering again without fruit; blossoms float through drowned doorways above last year's blossoms.

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: text-free painted environment layer for AshenSpire, not a screenshot. Style: polished hand-painted dark fantasy environment illustration matching the weathered stone, iron, aged brass and restrained ember warmth of the supplied style reference. Detailed tactile brushwork, atmospheric depth, natural silhouettes, no photographic look. Do not reproduce the reference architecture literally. No people, foreground characters, NPC identities, text, lettering, UI, borders, labels, numbers, stat values, map coordinates, logos or game symbols.
Primary request: Drowned Hamlet in a spring that will not turn: old stone and timber hamlet houses flooded through the doorways, tangled flowering branches with no fruit. Show fresh pale blossoms floating on dark water, and waterlogged brown blossoms visible beneath them by a foreground doorway. The landscape is too green despite the ruin. Landscape desktop composition: doorway and blossom layers clearly readable at left/center, hamlet extending behind, quieter dark water and mist at the right quarter for a future inspector. No flood wave or dramatic storm.
Orientation: wide landscape. Full-frame opaque background, text-free.
